App.NSCameraUsageDescription: OneRep uses the camera to photograph meals, scan barcodes on food packaging, and record video of your lifts so the form coach can check your technique.
App.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: OneRep reads Apple Health workouts, distance, heart rate, and routes to import cardio details, plus sleep, steps, resting heart rate, and heart rate variability so your coach can tell a hard week from an under-recovered one.
App.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: OneRep can save the strength sessions you finish here to Apple Health, so your training shows up alongside the rest of your activity.
App.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: OneRep connects to a OneRep server on your local network when you point it at one, so you can run your own instead of ours.
App.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: OneRep records your route and distance during a workout, including when the screen is locked or you use another app. Location tracking stops when you pause or finish.
App.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OneRep uses the microphone when you dictate a message to Coach.
App.NSMotionUsageDescription: OneRep reads device tilt so the hero artwork can drift as you move your phone.
App.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: OneRep saves a photo to your library only when you ask it to.
App.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OneRep reads the photo you pick so it can log the meal or read the barcode in it.
App.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: OneRep uses speech recognition to turn your Coach dictation into text.

OneRepWatch.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: OneRep reads your heart rate and active energy during a workout so it can show live stats and save an accurate session.
OneRepWatch.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: OneRep saves workouts you record on your watch to Health.
